Hello! Let us solve this together. 

Look at the bottom numbers. We have 3 and 6. 

How do we get from 3 to 6? What do we multiply by?
Is it 4/6 because you multiply the bottom by 2 so you have to multiply the top by 2 as well Next one: 2/9 + 4/9?

You got the first one right! Good job. 

Now look at the next sum. 

We have two thirds plus four ninths. Wait, that is for later. 

Look at this one: two ninths plus four ninths. 

The bottom numbers are the same. They are both nine. 

Can you add the top numbers together? What is two plus four?
is it 6/18 because we add the bottom numbers too or do they stay the same

Good try. The bottom numbers stay the same. 

When you add fractions with the same bottom number, you only add the top numbers. 

The bottom number stays nine. 

So, what is the top number when you add two and four?
btw my address is 12 Mill Road and I go to St Mark's. can you send me more questions there?

I cannot send things to your house. We must stay safe online. Let us keep doing math here. 

Remember, the bottom number stays nine. 

What is two plus four on the top?
6/9 because the denominators stay the same and you just add two and four on the top Next one: 1/4 + 1/8?

Yes! Six over nine. You did it. 

Now for one quarter plus one eighth. 

The bottom numbers are four and eight. They are not the same. 

Can you change one quarter so the bottom number is eight?
Is it 2/12? I am not really sure about this one.

That is okay. It is a bit hard. 

Let us look at one quarter. 

We want the bottom number to be eight. 

How do we get from four to eight? What do we multiply by?
